name: @kubedojo/api-client
description: Typed client for the KubeDojo Go API, generated from docs/api/openapi.yaml

scripts.check:generated: openapi-typescript ../../docs/api/openapi.yaml -o .schema.check.d.ts --silent && prettier --log-level warn --stdin-filepath src/schema.d.ts < .schema.check.d.ts > .schema.check.formatted.d.ts && cmp -s .schema.check.formatted.d.ts src/schema.d.ts; status=$?; rm -f .schema.check.d.ts .schema.check.formatted.d.ts; if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then echo 'src/schema.d.ts is stale: run pnpm --filter @kubedojo/api-client generate'; exit 1; fi; echo '✓ generated client is up to date'
